contents.description: 接触器测量链第 1 步（Start）的说明弹框；步骤 usingId 填本 id。
contents.title: 接触器检测
pages:
步骤1：将万用表拨至“Ω”挡，选择 R×100 量程。
步骤2：将红、黑表笔分别接触待测的两个端子。
步骤3：观察读数，判断触点的通断状态。

动断触点：静止时电阻为零（导通）；按下试验按键后电阻变为无穷大（OL）。
动合触点：静止时电阻为无穷大（OL）；按下试验按键后变为零（导通）。
线圈检测：若测得电阻在几百欧姆左右，说明线圈完好；若为 0 表示线圈短路；若为 OL 表示线圈断路。
contents.descriptionEn: Explanation dialog for step 1 (Start) of the contactor measurement chain; set the step usingId to this id.
pagesEn:
Step 1: Turn the multimeter to the "Ω" range and select the R×100 scale.
Step 2: Touch the red and black probes to the two terminals to be tested.
Step 3: Read the display and judge whether the contact is open or closed.

Normally-closed contact: at rest the resistance is zero (conducting); after the test button is pressed the resistance becomes infinite (OL).
Normally-open contact: at rest the resistance is infinite (OL); after the test button is pressed it becomes zero (conducting).
Coil test: if the measured resistance is around a few hundred ohms, the coil is intact; a reading of 0 means the coil is short-circuited; OL means the coil is open-circuited.

contents.description: 接触器测量链第 7 步（Finish）的结束说明；步骤 usingId 填本 id。
contents.title: 接触器检测 · 完成
pages: 本次检测完成：你已用万用表测出主触点、辅助触点与线圈的通断状态，并据此判断了触点类型。
检查要点：主触点 1L1-2T1、3L2-4T2、5L3-6T3 应两两导通（电阻接近 0）；线圈 A1-A2 应有几百欧姆电阻，读数为 0 表示线圈短路，显示 OL 表示线圈断路。
收纳：把红、黑表笔从端子上取下，万用表旋钮拨回 OFF 挡，整理好导线与器材。
contents.descriptionEn: Completion explanation for step 7 (Finish) of the contactor measurement chain; set the step usingId to this id.
pagesEn: This inspection is complete: you have used the multimeter to test the continuity of the main contacts, the auxiliary contacts and the coil, and have judged the contact types from the results.

Key checkpoints: the main contacts 1L1-2T1, 3L2-4T2 and 5L3-6T3 should conduct in pairs (resistance close to 0); the coil A1-A2 should have a resistance of a few hundred ohms; a reading of 0 means the coil is short-circuited, and OL means the coil is open-circuited.
Tidy up: remove the red and black probes from the terminals, turn the multimeter knob back to the OFF range, and put the leads and equipment away.
